notes: v263 — MILES-DISPATCH-GATE (owner, Mon Oct 26, 2026 08:25 MDT: 'If the Dispatch is active only then is it suppose to catch my inactive miles... Not if I am personally moving about'). v261 armed the date-keyed live-miles day watch whenever the app was alive, so personal movement on a no-work day was captured as day miles. App.armDayMiles (moved into the AUTOSTART-ENGINE region, beside the plan it now answers to) gates every passive arming on the engine's own dispatch-day resolution (autostartDispatchFor — autostartRecordDate semantics: scheduledAt date prefix or the record's `date` field; completed/cancelled claim nothing; an untimed record claiming today still counts). No dispatch for today: the watch is never armed, and one already armed stands down via LiveMiles.stopDay — which flushes and persists, so kilometres captured while a dispatch WAS active stay on the day; the stand-down stops future capture only, it erases nothing. Preserved exactly: the v261 auto-start plan behaviour (this gate touches miles capture, never the start); a running/paused session owns its miles — a manual start counts, dispatch or not; session start still adopts the day record whole (js/miles.js adoptableFragments); GeoLoads keeps its own arming (it rides LiveMiles, so the gate flows through); office role excluded. The boot/resume/30 s-watchdog calls re-evaluate the gate all day: a dispatch that lands mid-day (a message, a Connect share) arms capture from that point on — movement before it is not captured; that is the owner's rule working as intended. Harnesses: movement-arm 44 -> 76 (new section J: no-dispatch day never arms, tomorrow's dispatch does not arm today, timed + untimed + Connect-shaped records arm, completed/cancelled do not, a mid-day cancel stands down with the day record retained and a fresh dispatch re-arms the same record, session-owned miles untouched, office excluded, midnight-rollover stand-down, a session-keyed watch is never stood down); dispatch-autostart 73, pullgate 31, dispatch-ingest 217, dispatch-edit 82, manual-start-law 33, dispatch-cancelled-today 10 — all at baseline; background-day 35/4 and queue-v174 32/33 at their identical pre-existing baselines. js/app.js + tools/movement-arm-test.js + version.json only; modules/navigator.js untouched (the v262 traffic build is not in this ship).
